title: Panchayat Season 5: Prime Video sets a 3 December premiere
headline: Panchayat Season 5 Streams on Prime Video From 3 December
caption:
Panchayat Season 5 streams on Prime Video from Thursday, 3 December. Prime Video confirmed the date on 18 November, three days after the makers' 15 November post said the season wouldn't arrive this year.

The new season picks up after the Season 4 election, which Kranti Devi (Sunita Rajwar) won against Manju Devi (Neena Gupta). Her husband Banrakas (Durgesh Kumar) is now Phulera's Pradhanpati, and Jitendra Kumar is back as Sachiv Ji Abhishek Tripathi.

Raghubir Yadav, Faisal Malik, Chandan Roy, Sanvikaa and Ashok Pathak also return. TVF produces the show and Deepak Kumar Mishra directs it.

Sources: Prime Video, ANI, Outlook India, Esquire India, Open
